properties.notes: Proposed extension and external alterations to Sandyford House including the erection of four additional storeys to the existing building and 14 storey extensions to east and north elevations and change of use from offices (Class B1) to create 57 apartments (Class C3) on parts of the first to thirteenth floors and change of use of and extension to ground and lower ground floors to create commercial retail/financial and professional services/restaurant/drinking establishment units (Class A1 and/or A2 and /or A3 and/or A4) with erection of an associated cycle storage building to the east and landscaping works as amended.
